name: Hu Tao
notes: Both sources: 4pc Crimson Witch of Flames, Pyro DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Staff of Homa first. Sands differ: KQM EM or HP% (EM to about 100 first, then CRIT, then EM to 200-300, then HP%), Game8 HP% only; both are kept, HP% first. Game8 adds 4pc Shimenawa's Reminiscence and 4pc Marechaussee Hunter builds; KQM lists Shimenawa and Gilded Dreams. Scaling: her damage lines multiply ATK, but her ATK comes from a conversion of Max HP in Paramita Papilio, and both sources build HP%, so the card's scaling stat is HP. Her Normal Attack uses a curve of its own (1.78x at level 10), closest to the elemental table (1.8x), and is Pyro through the Burst/Skill state. KQM says she should not seek ER, so no ER goal. Neither source gives CRIT or HP goals. Partners: Hydro (Vaporize) and a Geo shielder, from her usual teams; the sources list none here.
